info.about: Metroid II: Return of Samus is a 1991 action-adventure game developed and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy. The first Metroid game for a handheld game console, it was released in North America in November 1991 and in Japan and Europe in 1992.
info.why: The 2017 3DS remake Samus Returns renewed demand for the 1991 original, which has only ever been reissued digitally.
